source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The signed-footer test waits for the second message window and OpenPGP processing after clicking Open and Show. It directly checks expected message text and absence of Content-Type in rendered body text. It does not check all outer headers, the added queue-ID header, raw saved bytes or icon status. Keep this visible-text regression assertion separate from a complete MIME or cryptographic guarantee.
title: The signed-footer Open and Show test checks visible Content-Type leakage only
